title: run_gap_check input
description: What is running that is not in the register? Runs live as the signed-in admin: the server exchanges the admin's token for a Power Platform API token and queries the inventory. Only unregistered items become claims. Registered components the check no longer sees become vanished claims. Long runs come back in pages: pass gapCheckRunId and skipToken to continue. compareOnly returns the comparison and writes no claims; validateOnly writes nothing at all.

estateKeys.description: Only these estates, from the estate value list. Leave out for every covered estate.

includeVanished.description: True also raises vanished claims for registered components no longer seen.

compareOnly.description: True returns the result and writes no claims.
